name: Cyber District
living: holographic billboards flicker and glitch now and then (glow mask)
the giant hologram face on the tower pulses and scanlines roll over it
flying cars stream slowly between the towers, their tail lights blinking
the vertical kanji neon sign buzzes with a rare soft flicker
the jumbotron's glowing baseball slowly spins and pulses
pink and violet neon reflections ripple across the rain-soaked field and puddles
rain falls in front of everything, with small splashes on the wet dirt
red beacons blink on the spire tips
the neon trim around the stands breathes softly
crowd shimmer, with camera flashes and a cheer pulse on a home run
note: fences in m at spray -45 (lf) / 0 (cf) / +45 (rf) deg, optional lcf / rcf at -22.5 / +22.5; wallHeight = the painted wall's height (m) at the fence (qa.py --wall-height); wallProfile (optional) = spray ranges where the painted wall is much taller/shorter; living = suggested living-painting details for this park (masks, sprites, shaders)
